runs.purpose: Implements a 32-entry hardware spinlock array: it samples bus_req_i, decodes an index, updates the corresponding lock bit lock_q(i) on a clock edge when the request and index select match, and returns lock state and handshake fields on bus_rsp_o. Registers are cleared on rstn_i.

flows.value: bus request strobe that begins an access and is reflected as the response ACK
update of a selected lock bit: conditional clocked assignment of lock_q(i) <= not bus_req_i.rw when the request, address decode and sel(i) match
return of lock state (masked by selection or full vector) on bus_rsp_o.data for read accesses
response fields ack and err driven each cycle (ack mirrors request strobe; err tied '0') and data defaulted to zero before conditional read assignment
lock_q entries cleared to '0' on rstn_i='0' and bus_rsp_o set to rsp_terminate_c while reset holds

concepts.concept: Bus request handshake (request strobe and response ACK) — the start event of an access and the ACK the module delivers
concepts.reasoning: The module echoes the request strobe into the response ACK and uses the strobe to qualify operations: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb (line 63; map: bus_rsp_o.ack COPIES at bus_rsp_o occurrence 3, line 63, targets bus_req_i.stb), and the strobe appears in the write and read gating conditions (lines 44, 66; map: bus_req_i.stb CARRIES at bus_req_i occurrence 6, line 63, targets bus_rsp_o.ack). Integrity of the request/ACK handshake is therefore established by the RTL assignments.

concepts.concept: Bus operation type (the rw bit) — the request's read/write indicator that determines the stored lock value and read behavior
concepts.reasoning: The rw field is consumed to form stored values and to choose the read path: `lock_q(i) <= not bus_req_i.rw;` (line 45; map: bus_req_i.rw SOURCES at bus_req_i occurrence 4, line 45, targets lock_q), and the response chooses the read branch when `(bus_req_i.rw = '0')` (line 66; map: bus_rsp_o.data GATED_BY at bus_rsp_o occurrence 6, line 68, targets bus_req_i.rw). The correctness of this rw-driven decision is required for the module's implemented update and read semantics.

runs.purpose: A 32-bit hardware spinlock array accessed over a bus: each lock bit lock_q(i) is reset to 0, can be written on a bus request whose address selects an index (sel(i)), and the module replies on the bus with ack/err/data derived from the stored lock bits.

flows.value: bus request strobe begins a bus transaction that the module observes (start of read or write)
write operation that sets or clears a lock bit: on a qualifying bus request the chosen lock_q(i) is updated from the request (not bus_req_i.rw) on the clock edge
bus-response production: on each clock the module drives bus_rsp_o.ack, bus_rsp_o.err and bus_rsp_o.data and implements read logic when stb and rw indicate a read
return of lock state: when a read to the locks is performed the reply data is either the masked single-bit vector (lock_q and sel) or the full lock_q vector
synchronous/asynchronous clear of state and response on reset: lock_q bits are cleared and bus_rsp_o is set to rsp_terminate_c on rstn_i = '0'
